lastResponse.text: First step: if you feel shaky, confused, very thirsty, vomiting, or faint, call nine one one now for urgent medical help. Quick safety check: are you feeling any of those right now? If you can make one call, Washington County Behavioral Health Hillsboro Recovery Center is 5 0 3 … 8 4 6 … 4 5 2 8. That is five zero three, eight four six, four five two eight.
originalTexts: First step: if you feel shaky, confused, very thirsty, vomiting, or faint, call **9-1-1 now** for urgent medical help. Quick safety check: are you feeling any of those right now? If you can make one call, Washington County Behavioral Health Hillsboro Recovery Center is **5 0 3** … **8 4 6** … **4 5 2 8**. That is **(503) 846-4528**.
